Synthetic contracts only; build-specific accuracy remains unvalidated.

files.limitations: Windows process/VAD kernel symbols required. XOR 0x2e/0x69 configurations matching pinned upstream signatures only; no coverage claim for all Cobalt Strike versions. Examines each selected process main executable DOS/Rich header only, at most 65.536 KB per header plus 64-byte DOS probe; 64 processes by default (1024 cap). Intel32/Intel64 declared; not validated across Windows builds. Reports layer, image base and Rich marker offset; MD5 of the decoded DanS-through-records header is a fingerprint, not attribution. Absent Rich header is empty; malformed/unreadable header is an error.
